items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: Sheep would tell you the same thing. Sheep had an old horn too... When I took the horn apart... I fixed the horn up... So, I said, Sheep, Howard, I learned you my horn.

ctx.x: Yeah. When I was doing trenchment work, I find horn and I passed the horn up myself. I passed the horn up. Sheep would tell you the same thing. Sheep had an old horn too. I'll tell you about this. Same time, when everybody's on the story, that, Sheep had an old horn, it was patched. It was all bent up. When I took the horn apart, I was doing metal work. I could do it good. I fixed the horn up. Yeah, not the horn could pick Howard. What Howard took and done. Howard took and, after I fixed the horn for Sheep,…
Man, you could let them go in the store there.
